# TC.SectionInfo

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.SectionInfo"></a>

### TC.SectionInfo

Complete native section readback. Index is a position, not stable identity;
removing an earlier section shifts later indexes. Filter array contains occupied
slots in native slot order; sparse slot indexes are carried explicitly. Native
capacity filters_count is not the number of populated array entries. Nonmanual
sections are readable but protected. Shared-group filters require explicit local
detachment before writes; multiplier readback preserves native float32 rounding.

### active

Current section enabled state.

```text
boolean
```

### capabilities

Dynamic active/group/multiplier/filters capabilities and reasons.

```text
table<string, TC.FieldSchema>
```

### filters

Complete populated normalized indexed filters.

```text
(TC.Config.Read.SectionFilter)[]
```

### filters_count

Native slot capacity, separately bounded by section_filters.

```text
integer
```

### group

Shared-group name; empty means local.

```text
string
```

### index

Native one-based current section index.

```text
integer
```

### is_manual

Whether native manual editing is permitted.

```text
boolean
```

### multiplier

Finite native multiplier readback, not a decimal-rounding promise.

```text
number
```

### type

Current native logistic-section enum name.

```text

```
